reasoning: Section 3(a)(1)(A)(ii)–(iv) requires a licensee who Shares Licensed Material under CC BY 4.0, including in modified form, to retain each respective copyright, license-reference, or warranty-disclaimer-reference notice supplied by the Licensor with the material. An item never supplied triggers no retention duty under A. Section 3(a)(2) allows reasonable presentation for the medium, means, and context, potentially by linking to a resource containing the required information. Section 3(a)(3) expressly refers to all information required by A, so a Licensor request requires removal of the requested A information to the extent reasonably practicable, including any of the three covered items.
